claims.text: Refractory alloying elements and Cu have a significant positive heat of mixing.
Machine-learning-based interatomic potentials for MD simulations can be used to design and optimize the composition of RHEA–Cu systems.
Machine-learning-based interatomic potentials for MD simulations can be used to optimize processing conditions for RHEA–Cu systems.
The proposed computational approach enables large-scale reaction between RHEAs and Cu.
The proposed computational approach enables a stable RHEA–Cu microstructure at high temperatures.
Optimized composition and processing conditions are the structural mediator leading to the predicted outcome.
DFT or MD simulations constitute the mechanism underlying the predicted large-scale reaction and stable microstructure.
The positive heat of mixing between refractory elements and Cu limits the formation of RHEA–Cu composite structures.
The accuracy of machine-learning interatomic potentials for predicting high-temperature RHEA–Cu behavior is uncertain.
